_comment: Run template for valladolid-uva: a daily change-point M&V baseline (ASHRAE Guideline 14) for each of the two buildings' electricity meters on the 2016 calendar year, weather-normalized on the publisher's daily NASA POWER temperature (stored as 'oat' on 'weather'; a daily mean, which is what a daily model needs). All days are modelled: a university building's weekends and academic breaks scatter a daily all-days model (G14 rejects it, honestly). The SEP chaining case in examples/valladolid/chaining.py models working days only, monthly and weighted by days, on a station OAT series; see docs/VALIDATION.md.
